Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_rdate date;
 v_local_time date;
BEGIN
 nullchk;
 SELECT name, r.return_user_id, r.return_date
 INTO :ctrl_blk_1.customer, :ctrl_blk_1.return_user_id, v_local_rdate --:ctrl_blk_1.return_date
 FROM return_advices r, consignee c
 WHERE return_advice_id = :CTRL_BLK_1.return_slip
 AND c.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND r.consignee_id = c.consignee_id (+)
 AND r.chapter_id = c.chapter_id (+)
 AND exists (SELECT 'x' FROM return_items
 WHERE return_advice_id = r.return_advice_id
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND move_date is null
 AND warehouse_id = :GLOBAL.warehouse);
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,v_local_rdate,v_local_time);
 :ctrl_blk_1.return_date := v_local_time;
 else
 :ctrl_blk_1.return_date := v_local_rdate;
 end if;
 
EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 show_error_dist('5712');
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
END;

Trigger.TriggerText:

 :return_items.reject_code := null;
ELSIF :return_items.s_restock = 'N' THEN

 :return_items.s_device_type := null;
 :return_items.s_rack_number := null;

ELSE

declare
 temp_inv_class varchar2(2);
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 if :s_restock = 'N'
 then
 :GLOBAL.inventory_class := 'DI';
 GO_ITEM('reject_code');
 elsif :s_restock = 'Y' then
 --Add check for inventory class--
 BEGIN
 SELECT inventory_class INTO temp_inv_class
 FROM shipped_products
 WHERE unit_id = :return_items.unit_id
 AND coll_date = :return_items.coll_date
 AND product_code = :return_items.product_code
 AND aliquot = :return_items.aliquot
 AND shipped_date = (SELECT max(shipped_date) from shipped_products
 WHERE unit_id = :return_items.unit_id
 AND coll_date = :return_items.coll_date
 AND product_code = :return_items.product_code
 AND aliquot = :return_items.aliquot);
 IF temp_inv_class = 'SP' THEN
 show_error_dist('9930');
 END IF;
 :GLOBAL.inventory_class := temp_inv_class; 
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 END;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 execute_trigger('check_no_location');
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_label_dats date;
 temp_count number(3);
begin
 if :s_restock is not null and :s_restock not in ('N','Y')
 then
 show_error_dist('4002');
 end if;
 IF :s_restock = 'Y' THEN
 --Check for expired product
 IF :return_items.exp_date < sysdate THEN
 show_error_dist('3701');
 END IF; 
 --Check for interdictions 
 begin
 begin
 select nvl(label_dats,sysdate-1000000)
 into temp_label_dats
 from components
 where unit_id = :return_items.unit_id
 and coll_date = :return_items.coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and product_code = :return_items.product_code
 and component_prefix = :return_items.aliquot;
 end;
 --
 -- Check if unit has interdictions
 --
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from unit_interdictions ui, valid_interdictions_lab vi
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = :return_items.unit_id
 and coll_date = :return_items.coll_date
 and ui.inter_code = vi.inter_code
 and vi.inter_type != 'I'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate)
 and insert_dats > temp_label_dats;
 if temp_count > 0
 then
 show_error_dist('3722'); -- unit interdicted
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end;
 begin
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from discard_products
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = :return_items.unit_id
 and product_code = :return_items.product_code
 and aliquot = :return_items.aliquot;
 show_error_dist('5311'); -- Product is placed on discard
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 null;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --
 -- check for component interdictions
 --
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from component_interdictions
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = :return_items.unit_id
 and coll_date = :return_items.coll_date
 and product_code = :return_items.product_code
 and insert_dats > temp_label_dats;
 if temp_count > 0
 then
 show_error_dist('3721'); -- component interdicted
 end if;
 end;
 end;
 end if;
end;

begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');

 execute_trigger('post_location');
 check_package_failure;
 --
 -- Default device
 --
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'S_DEVICE_NUMBER', INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('S_DEVICE_NUMBER',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'S_DEVICE_NUMBER', UPDATEABLE, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 begin
 NEXT_ITEM;
 select p.device_number
 into :s_device_number
 from product_storage p, storage_devices d
 where p.chapter_id = :loca_0.chapter_id
 and p.warehouse_id = :s_warehouse_id
 and p.product_type = :loca_0.product_type
 and sysdate between p.effective_date
 and nvl(p.term_date,sysdate)
 and d.chapter_id = p.chapter_id
 and d.warehouse_id = p.warehouse_id
 and d.device_type = p.device_type
 and d.device_number = p.device_number
 and sysdate between d.effective_date
 and nvl(d.term_date,sysdate);
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'S_DEVICE_NUMBER', INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0359');
 check_package_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 if substr(:GLOBAL.save_location,13) =
 :loca_0.storage_class||
 :loca_0.product_type||
 :loca_0.blood_type
 and substr(:GLOBAL.save_location,1,1) =
 :s_warehouse_id
 then
 :s_device_number := substr(:GLOBAL.save_location,3,2);
 else
 :s_device_number := '';
 end if;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

declare
 temp_tray_id VARCHAR2(5);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 if NVL(length(:s_tray_id), 0) != 6 and
 :s_tray_id != 'M'
 then
 :s_tray_id := '';
 :m_tray_id := '';
 show_error_dist('0700');-- invalid scan length
 check_package_failure;
 else
 if NVL(length(:s_tray_id), 0) = 6
 then
 validate_tray_number_scan(:s_tray_id,temp_tray_id);

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
begin
 if :m_tray_id != 'NONE'
 then
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select 'x'
 into :GLOBAL.x
 from trays
 where chapter_id = :loca_0.chapter_id
 and tray_number = :m_tray_id
 and sysdate between effective_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0341');
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select item_count, t.product_type||' '||abo_desc
 into temp_count, :GLOBAL.loc_desc
 from trays t, vserv_abo a
 where t.chapter_id = :loca_0.chapter_id
 and t.tray_number = :m_tray_id
 and t.warehouse_id = :s_warehouse_id
 and t.device_type = :s_device_type
 and t.device_number = :s_device_number
 and t.rack_number = :s_rack_number
 and t.shelf_number = :s_shelf_number
 and t.product_type = decode(:loca_0.mix_product,'N',
 :loca_0.product_type,t.product_type)
 and a.abo_code = t.blood_type
 and a.unit_scheme_type = :global.code_scheme
 and (:loca_0.blood_type = t.blood_type
 or :loca_0.mix_abo = 'Y'
 or(:loca_0.ship_any_rh = 'Y'
 and :loca_0.blood_type = a.order_abo_group))
 and sysdate between t.effective_date
 and nvl(t.term_date,sysdate)
 UNION
 select item_count, 'Empty Tray'
 from trays t
 where item_count = 0
 and t.chapter_id = :loca_0.chapter_id
 and t.tray_number = :m_tray_id
 and rack_number is null
 and sysdate between t.effective_date
 and nvl(t.term_date,sysdate);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0360');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in checking from trays');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :GLOBAL.location_id := :s_warehouse_id||
 :s_device_type||
 :s_device_number||
 :s_rack_number||
 :s_shelf_number||
 :m_tray_id;
 :GLOBAL.save_location := :GLOBAL.location_id||
 :loca_0.storage_class||
 :loca_0.product_type||
 :loca_0.blood_type;
 if temp_count > to_number(:loca_0.tray_capacity) - 1
 and :loca_0.tray_count != 1
 then
 GO_ITEM('conf_over_loc');
 end if;
 end if;
end;

 then

end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_move_date date := trunc(sysdate);
 temp_location_id varchar2(12);
 temp_inventory_class varchar2(2);
 temp_osok_flag varchar2(1);
begin
 execute_trigger('VALIDATE_RECORD');
 check_package_failure; 
 execute_trigger('VALIDATE_FIELD');
 check_package_failure;
 first_record;
 go_item('return_items.s_restock');
 loop
 if :s_restock is not null THEN
 if :s_restock = 'Y' THEN
 temp_location_id := :s_warehouse_id || :s_device_type || :s_device_number ||
 :s_rack_number || :s_shelf_number || :m_tray_id;
 begin
 select inventory_class, osok_flag
 into temp_inventory_class, temp_osok_flag
 from shipped_products
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = :return_items.unit_id
 and product_code = :return_items.product_code
 and aliquot = :return_items.aliquot
 and shipped_date = (Select max(shipped_date)
 from shipped_products
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = :return_items.unit_id
 and product_code = :return_items.product_code
 and aliquot = :return_items.aliquot);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 null;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
 begin
 insert into active_products
 (UNIT_ID, COLL_DATE, CHAPTER_ID, PRODUCT_CODE, ALIQUOT,
 BLOOD_TYPE, EXP_DATE, INSERT_DATE, APPL_CUSTODY,STOCK_STATE,
 LOCATION_ID, PRODUCT_TYPE, INVENTORY_CLASS, PROGRAM_ID,
 OSOK_FLAG, WAREHOUSE_ID)
 values(:return_items.unit_id, :return_items.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id, :return_items.product_code,
 :return_items.aliquot, :return_items.s_abo_code,
 :return_items.exp_date, sysdate, 'SV', 'AV',
 temp_location_id, :return_items.product_type,
 temp_inventory_class, :banner.prog_name,
 temp_osok_flag, :GLOBAL.warehouse);
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 message('error in inserting into active');
 handle_error;
 end;
 elsif :s_restock = 'N' THEN
 temp_location_id := 'DISCARD-BIN';
 begin
 insert into discard_products
 (CHAPTER_ID, UNIT_ID, COLL_DATE, ALIQUOT,
 PRODUCT_CODE, BLOOD_TYPE, PRODUCT_STATUS, PRODUCT_TYPE,
 EXP_DATE, DISCARD_TYPE, LOCATION_ID, INSERT_DATE,
 REJECT_REASON,PROGRAM_ID, WAREHOUSE_ID)

procedure abo_description is
begin
 select distinct abo_desc, abo_code
 into :return_items.s_abo_desc, :return_items.s_abo_code
 from vserv_abo, shipped_products
 where abo_code = blood_type
 and unit_scheme_type = decode(:return_items.chk_digit,NULL,'C','I')
 and unit_id = :return_items.unit_id
 and product_code = :return_items.product_code
 and aliquot = :return_items.aliquot
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and shipped_date =
 (select max(shipped_date)
 from shipped_products
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = :return_items.unit_id
 and product_code = :return_items.product_code
 and aliquot = :return_items.aliquot)
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
end;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_code number;
 temp_msg VARCHAR2(80);
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error_dist('0213');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error_dist('0214');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('0215');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error_dist('0216');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error_dist('0204');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error_dist('0217');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error_dist('0218');
 elsif error_code = 40209 -- invalid entry format
 then
 show_error_dist('0246');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('0215');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error_dist('0000');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error_dist('0601');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026,0)
 then
 declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(20);
 begin
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2))='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error_dist('0251',disp_format_mask);
 show_error_dist('0251',GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 end;
 elsif error_code = 50025 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error_dist('0509');
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error_dist('0220');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error_dist('0331');
 elsif error_code in ('40209','40735') then
 null;
 else -- unhandled Forms errors
 message('FRMS ' || to_char(error_code) || ':' || error_text);
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
end;
